proof_body:
by
  intro a r x hr hs hx
  have hsum : ∀ y : ℝ, |y| < r → Summable (fun n => a n * y ^ n) := fun y hy =>
    Summable.of_norm_bounded hs fun n => by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have : |y| ^ n ≤ r ^ n := by gcongr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg _)
  have hxs : |x| < (|x| + r) / 2 := by linarith
  have hsr : (|x| + r) / 2 < r := by linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < (|x| + r) / 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨s, hs_def⟩ : ∃ s, s = (|x| + r) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hs_def] at hxs hsr hs0
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ s / r := by positivity
  have hq1 : s / r < 1 := (div_lt_one hr).2 hsr
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * (s / r) ^ n + (s / r) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_self_mul_const_pow_of_lt_one hq0 hq1).add (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq0 hq1)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.1 (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto _ hlim)
  have hbd : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) + 1) * s ^ n ≤ C / r * r ^ (n + 1) := fun n => by
    have h1 := (le_abs_self _).trans (hC _ ⟨n, rfl⟩)
    have e1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * s ^ n = ((n : ℝ) * (s / r) ^ n + (s / r) ^ n) * r ^ n := by
      rw [div_pow]; field_simp
    have e2 : C / r * r ^ (n + 1) = C * r ^ n := by rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
    rw [e1, e2]
    gcongr
  have hu : Summable (fun n : ℕ => |a (n + 1)| * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * s ^ n)) := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_)
      (((summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 hs).mul_left (C / r))
    calc |a (n + 1)| * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * s ^ n) ≤ |a (n + 1)| * (C / r * r ^ (n + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbd n) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = C / r * (|a (n + 1)| * r ^ (n + 1)) := by ring
  have hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ), |y| < s → ‖a (n + 1) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * y ^ n)‖ ≤ |a (n + 1)| * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * s ^ n) := by
    intro n y hy
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1)]
    gcongr
  have hmem : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) s := by simpa using hxs
  have key : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => ∑' n : ℕ, a (n + 1) * z ^ (n + 1))
      (∑' n : ℕ, a (n + 1) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x ^ n)) x := by
    refine hasDerivAt_tsum_of_isPreconnected (g := fun (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) => a (n + 1) * z ^ (n + 1))
      (g' := fun (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) => a (n + 1) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * z ^ n)) (y₀ := x) hu Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball (0 : ℝ) s).isPreconnected ?_ ?_ hmem ?_ hmem
    · intro n y _
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow (n + 1) y).const_mul (a (n + 1))
      simpa using this
    · intro n y hy
      exact hbound n y (by simpa using hy)
    · exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 (hsum x (hxs.trans hsr))
  have hev : (fun y : ℝ => ∑' n, a n * y ^ n) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun y => a 0 + ∑' n : ℕ, a (n + 1) * y ^ (n + 1) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (sub_pos.2 hx)] with y hy
    have hy' : |y| < r := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub y x
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hy
      linarith [le_abs_self (y - x)]
    rw [(hsum y hy').tsum_eq_zero_add]
    simp
  have e : (∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) + 1) * a (n + 1) * x ^ n) = ∑' n : ℕ, a (n + 1) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x ^ n) :=
    tsum_congr fun n => by ring
  constructor
  · refine Summable.of_norm_bounded hu fun n => ?_
    have := hbound n x hxs
    rwa [show ((n : ℝ) + 1) * a (n + 1) * x ^ n = a (n + 1) * (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x ^ n) by ring]
  · rw [e]
    exact (key.const_add (a 0)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (r x : ℝ), 0 < r → Summable (fun n => |a n| * r ^ n) → |x| < r → Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * a (n + 1) * x ^ n) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ∑' n, a n * y ^ n) (∑' n : ℕ, ((n : ℝ) + 1) * a (n + 1) * x ^ n) x
